description:
Expand the Urban Electronics business by creating a new European storefront and assigning products to it.

1. Create a new Store entity with the following details:
   - Name: 'Urban Electronics Europe'
   - Email: 'europe@urbanelectronics.com'
   - Default Currency: Euro (EUR)
   - Address: 10 Oxford Street, London, W1D 1BS, United Kingdom
   - The store should be active but NOT set as the default store.

2. Assign the following existing products to the new European store (they must also remain available in the US store):
   - Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
   - Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
   - Logitech MX Master 3S

You can access the store configuration at Commerce > Configuration > Stores.
